accepted_limits: This is a focused real-environment smoke for DOCX to ODT only; it does not close WPS application fidelity beyond focused rich roundtrip, LibreOffice-only fallback, comments, fields, revisions, complex layout, or broad binary artifact comparison.
ODT output is validated as a real zip package with content.xml selected text. Size is recorded as environment metadata; this smoke does not require broad byte parity.

Old Tk and old PySide6 explicitly route DOCX to ODT as Word then LibreOffice and do not include WPS. The current rewrite now skips WPS for any ODT source/target route to preserve that old-system/product boundary.

pre_fix_current_risk.observed: current DOCX to ODT previously allowed WPS Writer as the first COM candidate and could return success with a non-zip .odt output
pre_fix_current_risk.fix: docwen_plugin_document.to_document.converter._word_candidates now returns only Microsoft Word for ODT source or target routes; LibreOffice fallback remains wired through docwen_core.office_bridge
